description: Independently verified evidence items for this match's Data Dashboard. Additive: never edits bundle.json or raw_data. Lists only items confirmed by a check other than the per-minute Gemini analysis itself. An empty list means nothing has been independently verified.

items.claim: In minute 00:00-01:00, with PSG in possession, the ball zone was the middle third.

time_range_sec.basis: seconds from the start of the match video; the first 30 s of the minute

items.how_verified: Automatic cross-check against computer-vision ball tracking over the first 30 seconds of the minute: the tracked ball was in the middle third (relative to the possessing team's attacking direction) in the majority of frames, matching the Gemini label.
items.limits: Covers only the first 30 s of a 60 s minute and only the ball_zone field of that one minute. It does not verify any aggregate statistic shown on the dashboard.
